differences: Scope extension to four already-approved fresh n3 seeds. Underlying numerical implementation is reused unchanged, including its non-A0030.10 allocator fraction; external guards replace original six-run A003 queue admission. contrary_evidence: A numerical pass cannot prove all-input stability, resolve GPU hang root cause, establish causal effects of calibration or guarantee useful object representations/planning. Seed0 success does not establish later seeds. Smaller allocator cap may fail operationally and is not a scientific negative.
